description: List the cities that currently have one-way campervan relocation deals starting or ending there, with coordinates, deal counts and providers. Optionally count only deals that overlap a travel window or come from given providers. Use it to find the exact city names search_deals accepts, or the nearest city with deals to a place that has none. Read-only.

end_date.description: Last day of the travel window, YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps deals whose own window starts on or before it.

providers.description: Only these providers: roadsurfer (Roadsurfer), indiecampers (IndyCampers), imoova (Imoova). Leave out for all three.

start_date.description: First day of the travel window, YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps deals whose own window ends on or after it.

name: list_cities

deals_from.description: Deals that start in this city.

deals_to.description: Deals that end in this city.

map_url.description: Camper Rally Map opened on this city.

title: List cities with deals
